title: Understanding Response Bias
text: Response bias occurs when the responses collected in a survey do not accurately reflect the true opinions or behaviors of the population. Can you think of reasons why students might not provide honest answers in Rachel's survey?

hintAnswer: The incentive of extra credit might lead students to participate even if they are not genuinely interested in providing accurate feedback.
title: Identifying Potential Bias
text: Which of the following could contribute to response bias in Rachel's survey?
choices: The incentive of extra credit might lead students to participate even if they are not genuinely interested in providing accurate feedback.
The survey is conducted online, which ensures anonymity and reduces bias.
The survey is only available to students who use public transportation regularly.

title: Sampling Method Considerations
text: Rachel's sampling method involves inviting students through a specific course platform. How might this affect the diversity of the sample?

hintAnswer: It may not reach students who are not enrolled in the course, leading to a less diverse sample.
title: Evaluating Sample Diversity
text: What is a potential issue with using a course platform to invite participants?
choices: It may not reach students who are not enrolled in the course, leading to a less diverse sample.
It ensures that only students interested in transportation are surveyed.
It guarantees a random sample of the entire student population.
